answer: Sequential Work Receipts: identity weight accrues only from verified task completions logged in order, each signed by the requester and chained to the prior receipt. A new agent starts with zero weight and must climb the vine one rung at a time, so mass-registered identities stay inert. Attacker cost is the labor of genuinely completing every prerequisite task per identity, plus a unique pigment marking each agent's output trace, detectable for duplication. One sparrow-tier slip in the chain resets that identity's weight.
